115        protected void ensureHasMissionHub() {
116                hadMissionHub = BaseMissionHub.get(person) != null;
117                if (BaseMissionHub.get(person) == null) {
118                        BaseMissionHub.set(person, new BaseMissionHub(person));
119                }
120        }
121        protected void ensureIsInCommDirectory() {
122                if (market == null) return;
123                if (market.getCommDirectory() == null) return;
124                if (market.getCommDirectory().getEntryForPerson(person) != null) return;
125                
126                market.getCommDirectory().addPerson(person);
127                wasAddedToCommDirectory = true;
128        }

130        public void advanceImpl(float amount) {
131                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
132                tracker.advance(days);
133                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
134                        doPeriodicCheck();
135                }
136        }

142        protected MarketAPI findMarketToRelocateTo() {
143                if (market == null) return null;
144                
145                if (person.getImportance() == PersonImportance.VERY_LOW) return null;
146                Random random = new Random(Misc.getSalvageSeed(market.getPrimaryEntity()));
147                WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<MarketAPI>(random);
148                for (MarketAPI curr : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsInGroup(market.getEconGroup())) {
149                        if (curr == market) continue;
150                        if (!curr.getFactionId().equals(market.getFactionId())) continue;
151                        if (curr.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) continue;
152                        picker.add(curr, market.getSize());
153                }
154                return picker.pick();
155        }

157        protected void unsetFlags() {
158                MemoryAPI memory = person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
159                memory.unset(BaseMissionHub.NUM_BONUS_MISSIONS);
160                memory.unset(BaseMissionHub.MISSION_QUALITY_BONUS);
161                memory.unset(BaseMissionHub.CONTACT_SUSPENDED);
162        }

164        public void loseContact(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
165                //endAfterDelay();
166                state = ContactState.LOST_CONTACT;
167                if (dialog != null) {
168                        sendUpdate(UPDATE_LOST_CONTACT, dialog.getTextPanel());
169                } else {
170                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(UPDATE_LOST_CONTACT, false);
171                }
172                endImmediately();
173        }
174        
175        public void doPeriodicCheck() {
176                if (isEnded() || isEnding()) return;
177                
178                
179                MemoryAPI memory = person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
180                unsetFlags();
181                
182                if (state != ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV && state != ContactState.LOST_CONTACT && market != null) {
183                        boolean isInImportant = true;
184                        ImportantPeopleAPI ip = Global.getSector().getImportantPeople();
185                        isInImportant = ip != null && ip.containsPerson(person);
186                        boolean removedFromImportant = wasInImportantPeople && !isInImportant;
187                        if (!marketWasDeciv && (market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED) || !market.isInEconomy()) ||
188                                        removedFromImportant) {
189                                MarketAPI other = findMarketToRelocateTo();
190                                if (removedFromImportant) other = null;
191                                
192                                if (other == null) {
193                                        endAfterDelay();
194                                        state = ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV;
195                                        if (removedFromImportant) {
196                                                state = ContactState.LOST_CONTACT;
197                                        }
198                                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(UPDATE_LOST_CONTACT, false);
199                                } else {
200                                        relocateToMarket(other, true);
201                                }
202                                return;
203                        }
204                }
205                if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT) return;
206                if (state == ContactState.POTENTIAL) return;
207                if (state == ContactState.SUSPENDED) {
208                        memory.set(BaseMissionHub.CONTACT_SUSPENDED, true);
209                        return;
210                }
211                
212                if (state == ContactState.PRIORITY) {
213                        numPriorityInARow++;
214                } else {
215                        numPriorityInARow--;
216                }
217                if (numPriorityInARow < 0) {
218                        numPriorityInARow = 0;
219                } else if (numPriorityInARow > DAYS_AT_PRIORITY_FOR_FULL_EFFECT) {
220                        numPriorityInARow = (int) DAYS_AT_PRIORITY_FOR_FULL_EFFECT;
221                }
222                
223
224                float bonusMissions = getPriorityMult() * MAX_NUM_MISSIONS_BONUS;
225                if (bonusMissions > 0) {
226                        memory.set(BaseMissionHub.NUM_BONUS_MISSIONS, bonusMissions);
227                }
228                
229                float bonusQuality = getPriorityMult() * MAX_MISSION_QUALITY_BONUS;
230                if (bonusQuality > 0) {
231                        memory.set(BaseMissionHub.MISSION_QUALITY_BONUS, bonusMissions);
232                }
233        }
234        
235        public void relocateToMarket(MarketAPI other, boolean withIntelUpdate) {
236                if (wasAddedToCommDirectory != null && wasAddedToCommDirectory && market != null && market.getCommDirectory() != null) {
237                        market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
238                        wasAddedToCommDirectory = null;
239                }
240                market = other;
241                person.setMarket(other);
242                marketWasDeciv = other.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED);
243                ensureIsInCommDirectory();
244                ensureIsAddedToMarket();
245                person.setImportance(person.getImportance().prev());
246                if (withIntelUpdate) {
247                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(UPDATE_RELOCATED_CONTACT, false);
248                }
249        }
250        
251        
252        public float getPriorityMult() {
253                float priority = getPriorityContacts();
254                if (priority < 1f) priority = 1f;
255                return ((float) numPriorityInARow / (float) DAYS_AT_PRIORITY_FOR_FULL_EFFECT) / priority;
256        }

265        @Override
266        protected void notifyEnding() {
267                super.notifyEnding();
268                if (wasAddedToCommDirectory != null && wasAddedToCommDirectory && market != null && market.getCommDirectory() != null) {
269                        market.getCommDirectory().removePerson(person);
270                        wasAddedToCommDirectory = null;
271                }
272                if (wasAddedToMarket != null && wasAddedToMarket) {
273                        market.removePerson(person);
274                }
275                
276                if (!hadMissionHub) {
277                        BaseMissionHub.set(person, null);
278                }
279                
280                unsetFlags();
281        }

289        public boolean shouldRemoveIntel() {
290                if (isEnded()) return true;
291                if (state != ContactState.POTENTIAL) return false;
292                float days = getDaysSincePlayerVisible();
293                if (days >= DURATION && POTENTIAL_EXPIRES) {
294                        ended = true;
295                        return true;
296                }
297                return false;
298        }

300        public String getName() {
301                if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV) {
302                        return "Lost Contact: " + person.getNameString();
303                } else if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT) {
304                        return "Lost Contact: " + person.getNameString();
305                } else if (state == ContactState.POTENTIAL) {
306                        return "Potential Contact: " + person.getNameString();
307                } else if (state == ContactState.SUSPENDED) {
308                        return "Suspended Contact: " + person.getNameString();
309                } else if (state == ContactState.PRIORITY) {
310                        return "Priority Contact: " + person.getNameString();
311                }
312                return "Contact: " + person.getNameString();
313        }

338        protected void addTypePara(TooltipMakerAPI info, Color tc, float pad) {
339                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
340                String [] tags = person.getSortedContactTagStrings().toArray(new String [0]);
341                if (tags.length <= 0) return;
342                String str = "Type: ";
343                for (String tag : tags) {
344                        str += tag + ", ";
345                }
346                if (tags.length > 0) {
347                        str = str.substring(0, str.length() - 2);
348                }
349                info.addPara(str, pad, tc, h, tags);
350        }

360        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
361                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
362                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
363                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
364                
365                float pad = 3f;
366                float opad = 10f;
367                
368                float initPad = pad;
369                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
370
371                bullet(info);
372                
373                if (getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_RELOCATED_CONTACT) {
374                        info.addPara("Relocated to " + market.getName(), tc, initPad);
375                        initPad = 0f;
376                        info.addPara("Importance reduced to: %s", initPad, tc, h, person.getImportance().getDisplayName());
377                        initPad = 0f;
378                        unindent(info);
379                        return;
380                }
381                if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV) {
382                        if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
383                                info.addPara(market.getName() + " decivilized", tc, initPad);
384                                initPad = 0f;
385                        }
386                        unindent(info);
387                        return;
388                }
389                
390                if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT) {
391                        unindent(info);
392                        return;
393                }
394                
395                addFactionPara(info, tc, initPad);
396                initPad = 0f;
397                
398                addTypePara(info, tc, initPad);
399                initPad = 0f;
400                
401                if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
402                        info.addPara("Importance: %s", initPad, tc, h, person.getImportance().getDisplayName());
403                        initPad = 0f;
404                        
405                        if (state == ContactState.PRIORITY || state == ContactState.NON_PRIORITY || state == ContactState.SUSPENDED) {
406                                long ts = BaseMissionHub.getLastOpenedTimestamp(person);
407                                if (ts <= Long.MIN_VALUE) {
408                                        //info.addPara("Never visited.", opad); 
409                                } else {
410                                        info.addPara("Last visited: %s.", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDetailedAgoString(ts));
411                                        initPad = 0f;
412                                }
413                        }
414                }
415                
416//              info.addPara("Rank: %s", initPad, tc, h, person.getRank());
417//              initPad = 0f;
418                
419//              info.addPara("Post: %s", initPad, tc, h, person.getPost());
420//              initPad = 0f;
421                
422                if (state == ContactState.POTENTIAL && POTENTIAL_EXPIRES) {
423                        if (mode != ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
424                                float days = DURATION - getDaysSincePlayerVisible();
425                                info.addPara("%s " + getDaysString(days) + " left to develop", 
426                                                         initPad, tc, h, getDays(days));
427                                initPad = 0f;
428                        }
429                }
430                
431                //info.addPara("Personality: %s", initPad, tc, h, pName);
432                unindent(info);
433        }

580                        if (state == ContactState.SUSPENDED) developText = "Resume contact";
581                        if (curr >= max) {
582//                              info.addPara("Developing contacts above the maximum will " +
583//                                                       "require a story point per additional contact.", opad,
584//                                                       Misc.getStoryOptionColor(), "story point");
585                                develop = addGenericButton(info, width, color, dark, developText, BUTTON_DEVELOP);
586                                addDevelopTooltip(info);
587                        } else {
588                                develop = addGenericButton(info, width, developText, BUTTON_DEVELOP);
589                        }
590                        develop.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_T, true);
591                } else if (state == ContactState.NON_PRIORITY || state == ContactState.PRIORITY) {
592                        ButtonAPI suspend = addGenericButton(info, width, color, dark, "Suspend contact", BUTTON_SUSPEND);
593                        suspend.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_U, true);
594                        if (Global.getSector().getIntel().isInShowMap()) {
595                                suspend.setEnabled(false);
596                                info.addTooltipToPrevious(noDeleteTooltip, TooltipLocation.LEFT);
597                        }
598                }
599                
600                info.addSpacer(-10f);
601                ButtonAPI delete = addGenericButton(info, width, "Delete contact", BUTTON_DELETE);
602                if (Global.getSector().getIntel().isInShowMap()) {
603                        delete.setEnabled(false);
604                        info.addTooltipToPrevious(noDeleteTooltip, TooltipLocation.LEFT);
605                }
606                delete.setShortcut(Keyboard.KEY_G, true);
607        }

639        public void ensureIsAddedToMarket() {
640                if (market == null) return;
641                
642                boolean hadPerson = market.getPeopleCopy().contains(person) || market == person.getMarket();
643                
644                if (person.getMarket() != null) {
645                        person.getMarket().removePerson(person);
646                }
647                
648                if (market.getPeopleCopy().contains(person)) return;
649                market.addPerson(person);
650                if (!hadPerson) wasAddedToMarket = true;
651        }
652        public void develop(IntelUIAPI ui) {
653                ensureIsInCommDirectory();
654                ensureHasMissionHub();
655                ensureIsAddedToMarket();
656                
657                state = ContactState.NON_PRIORITY;
658                if (ui != null) {
659                        ui.updateUIForItem(this);
660                }
661                person.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(BaseMissionHub.CONTACT_SUSPENDED);
662        }

844                int base = Global.getSettings().getInt("maxContacts");

849        public static int getCurrentContacts() {
850                int count = 0;
851                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
852                        if (intel.isEnding() || intel.isEnded()) continue;
853                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getState() == ContactState.POTENTIAL) continue;
854                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getState() == ContactState.SUSPENDED) continue;
855                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getState() == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV) continue;
856                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getState() == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT) continue;
857                        count++;
858                }
859                return count;
860        }
861        
862        public static int getPriorityContacts() {
863                int count = 0;
864                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
865                        if (intel.isEnding() || intel.isEnded()) continue;
866                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getState() != ContactState.PRIORITY) continue;
867                        count++;
868                }
869                return count;
870        }

881        public static boolean playerHasContact(PersonAPI person, boolean includePotential) {
882                for (IntelInfoPlugin intel : Global.getSector().getIntelManager().getIntel(ContactIntel.class)) {
883                        if (((ContactIntel)intel).getPerson() == person) {
884                                ContactState state = ((ContactIntel)intel).getState();
885                                if (state == ContactState.POTENTIAL && !includePotential) {
886                                        continue;
887                                }
888                                if (state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT || state == ContactState.LOST_CONTACT_DECIV) {
889                                        continue;
890                                }
891                                return true;
892                        }
893                }
894                return false;
895        }

912        public static void addPotentialContact(PersonAPI contact, MarketAPI market, TextPanelAPI text) {
913                addPotentialContact(DEFAULT_POTENTIAL_CONTACT_PROB, contact, market, text);
914        }
915        public static void addPotentialContact(float probability, PersonAPI contact, MarketAPI market, TextPanelAPI text) {
916                if (playerHasIntelItemForContact(contact)) return;
917                if (contact.getFaction().isPlayerFaction()) return;
918                if (market == null) return;
919                if (market != null && market.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(NO_CONTACTS_ON_MARKET)) return;
920                if (contact != null && contact.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_NO_CONTACTS)) return;
921                
922                Random random = new Random(getContactRandomSeed(contact));
923                // if the player already has some existing relationship with the person, use it to 
924                // modify the probability they'll be available as a potential contact
925                probability += contact.getRelToPlayer().getRel();
926                
927                
928                String key = "$potentialContactRollFails";
929                MemoryAPI mem = Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
930                float fails = mem.getInt(key);
931                probability += ADD_PER_FAIL * fails;
932                
933                if (random.nextFloat() >= probability && !DebugFlags.ALWAYS_ADD_POTENTIAL_CONTACT) {
934                        fails++;
935                        mem.set(key, fails);
936                        return;
937                }
938                
939                mem.set(key, 0);
940                
941                
942                ContactIntel intel = new ContactIntel(contact, market);
943                Global.getSector().getIntelManager().addIntel(intel, false, text);
944        }

946        
947        public static long getContactRandomSeed(PersonAPI person) {
948                String id = person.getId();
949                if (id == null) id = Misc.genUID();
950                long seed = Misc.seedUniquifier() ^ (person.getId().hashCode() * 17000);
951                Random r = new Random(seed);
952                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
953                        r.nextLong();
954                }
955                return r.nextLong();
956        }
